before: A checkpoint wrote no cell of a column that a take-back or a reject removed, and so no width record that a later column made from that cell held there. After a reopen, a reject of the later column gave its width to no cell.
after: A checkpoint writes such a record on the cell that takes the removed cell's space, by the engine's rule, with the width compose draws, so a reject of the later column gives the width back as it does live.
reason: Change messages, the change log, the manifest fields and the Yjs format do not change: the manifest lists the record on another cell with the fields it already has, and every reader reads it as before. A room admits only clients of its own code version.
